newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures hold gains on short covering.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures hold gains on short covering.

text.p: CME lumber futures continued to show gains in slow trade and ended higher on light short covering support, traders said.
Lumber closed $5.30 to $1.50 per tbf higher with September up $2.20 at $345.00 and November up $2.80 at $343.60 per tbf.

Short covering developed after the recent sharp break that took futures to 1-1/2 week lows on Wednesday. Locals accounted for the bulk of activity as many traders were awaiting the next move in cash, traders said.
Cash spruce will likely be quoted lower on Friday, pit sources added.
